name: Rokon Jet Hokkaido (ロコンジェット北海道)
description: AIRDO's Pokémon special on 767-300ER JA607A, a different design on each side: on the left, Alolan Vulpix (Rokon) in white and pale blue over a pale-blue fin and snowy scenes along the cabin; on the right, Vulpix in orange over a yellow fin and crown, with sunflowers along the cabin. 'AIR DO' kept in dark letters over the forward windows on both sides.

sources.note: JA607A became Rokon Jet Hokkaido, replacing the Bear Do Hokkaido JET (767 JA602A, last flight 2021-12-09).

logos.description: Alolan Vulpix large on the pale-blue fin (left side); Vulpix on the yellow fin (right side). Pokémon artwork, never drawn from here.
Vulpix and Alolan Vulpix scenes along the cabin: snowy on the left, sunflowers on the right.

notes: Described in words only: the open photos are a night three-quarter view of the left (2025-03-24), a far left side (2022-03-31) and a far right side (2025-04-23, CC0); none measurable for art that covers the aircraft, and the sides differ. In service from December 2021 (five years planned, so to about the end of 2026); named as flying in June 2025; flight-tracking sites show it flying to July 2026 (leads only). Draw it if side-on open photos of both sides appear; check it's still painted after December 2026.
history: New 2026-11-22. The Bear Do Hokkaido JET (767 JA602A, the mascot and Hokkaido's seasons, a smiling bear face on the fin) it replaced retired in December 2021.
